'''Rossini''' is a male [[NPC]] who was once an Acolyte, but then became the "chef" for the Troupe of Fools. He creates eccentric dishes based off performances.

''(Not in any quest or event yet)'' <!-- Remove if the NPC appears in any quest/events -->

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Rossini:'''  Hmm... These botched recreations. But I guess I'll have to finish them off anyway.
:'''Rossini:''' The taste and presentation might be lacking, but it's still edible!
:'''Rossini:''' Oh my! This one is... Poached Egg with Slug Relish, from "The Merchant of Ragunna."
:'''Rossini:''' Seems the slug meat got overcooked. No wonder Gisle's jaw started twitching halfway through his lines...
:'''Rossini:''' And here we have the Layered Yak Short Rib Bake... Must be the family feast main course from Act 3, Scene 6 of "The Lady of Cammellya."
:'''Rossini:''' Ugh, this yak meat is far too fatty. No wonder Heather's aria sounded like it was dripping in butter...
----
;(Unknown prompt and conversation)
:'''{{DIcon}}''' (Narrator: A mere infatuation is far from enough. What Chappell, now fallen to mortality, needs is a heart consumed by desire. Without it, anyone's love is nothing but a delusion!
:'''{{DIcon}}''' (Narrator: The doctrines that sever human desires and the silence, the tasteless laws and divine meals, now only provoke her instinctive revulsion--)
:'''{{DIcon}}''' I don't need a sermon, Acolyte Bugatti. Either shut up or join me in enjoying this delicious Golden Crab Pie.
:'''{{DIcon}}''' Don't look at me like that, Bugatti. I'm not the Acolyte you once knew.
:'''{{DIcon}}''' Call me Chappel... My name is Chappel-Romanya, Lord Bugatti.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Rossini:''' Hello there, {{Rover}}! I'm testing out some new recipes, but I won't invite you to sample them just yet.
:{{DIcon}} All these dishes are...
:'''Rossini:''' Yes, inspired by the plays, you see. Though recreating them has proven to be a bit more troublesome than I anticipated.
:'''Rossini:''' Golden Crab Pie is one of my few triumphant creations!
:'''Rossini:''' I'm Rossini. I didn't get the chance to introduce myself during today's rehearsal. I used to work in the kitchens of the Order of the Deep, preparing meals for the council members.
:{{DIcon}} Why did the Order exile you?
:'''Rossini:''' I merely enhanced the council's meals—naturally, in the best way possible.
:'''Rossini:''' The head chef accused me of using sinister methods to incite the Acolytes' appetites, corrupting their piety and undermining the Order.
:'''Rossini:''' Heretic, he called me... a laughable but effective accusation.
----
:'''Rossini:''' Hey! Want to try my first latest dish?
:'''{{DIcon}}''' Your first dish?
:'''{{DIcon}}''' Your latest dish?
:'''Rossini:''' Ah, yes! This is inspired by a performance I saw. A true Rinascita culinary creation, born from the stage!
:'''Rossini:''' Place a [[Goldcrest Scarab]] into a pie, baked with [[Mastic Nuvola]] and [[Viscum Berry]]... then nestle it in a [[Bell Crab]] shell, arranging it just so, to mimic the playful movements of the scarab...
:'''{{DIcon}}''' Goldcrest Scarab?
:'''{{DIcon}}''' Bell Crab's shell?
:'''Rossini:''' Yes, exactly! Isn't it fascinating? To help the actors truly feel their roles, I've gone all in to recreate these legendary dishes!
:'''Rossini:''' So, what do you think? Want to try this dish- the one that brings "Chappell Romanya" back to the mortal realm, but leaves "Acolyte Bugatti" with the most perplexed expression?
:'''{{DIcon}}''' Sure!
::'''Abby:''' No, no, no! No way! There's just no way!! You eat it, I'm not eating it!
::'''Rover:''' Scared you enough to jolt you awake?
:'''{{DIcon}}''' Maybe not...
:'''Rossini:''' Hey! Are you sure you don't want to give it a try? I can guarantee this dish has a flavor like no other!

{{Dialogue End}}
